::: {.callout-warning title="BNR team draft"}
This page is a deliberately light structure for the BNR team to complete. Replace the prompts with the procedure staff actually use; remove anything that is not useful.
:::

## Purpose

Briefly explain how BNR identifies a potential cardiovascular event and decides whether it should proceed to abstraction.

## When this applies

List the sources, circumstances and frequency covered by this procedure.

## Responsibilities

Name the operational roles that search sources, assess potential events, resolve uncertainty and sign off completion.

## What to document

Consider including:

- the sources that are checked and how often;
- the minimum information recorded at first identification;
- how an existing event is distinguished from a new event;
- the possible assessment outcomes and standard exclusion reasons; and
- when clinical or operational advice is required.

## Stop and escalate

Describe the few uncertainties that mean staff must pause rather than create or exclude a record.

## Records to retain

State where the assessment decision and its supporting reference are recorded.
